column1: # Indiana Jones 3 (indy3kor korean.trs), U preset: 2 bpp, I3KO.MAP's default (true-colour) preset.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# Dialogue, verbs, sentence line (charset 0): NanumGothic-Bold. Title card (charset 1): GowunBatang-Bold.
# Size and ascent are what mkfont.py --fit-cell picks for the charset's cell over the
# korean.trs text (no glyph leaves the cell): Nanum 16x16 -> 15/14, Gowun 18x18 -> 18/16.
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
